metadataRaw.title: How to Relieve Inner Leg Pain IN SECONDS
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates simple exercises to quickly relieve inner leg, thigh, and groin pain.

These exercises target the main muscles in this area — particularly the adductor muscle group (located on the inner thigh). We’ll focus on both stretching and strengthening these muscles for quick and long-lasting relief.

All of the exercises can be done at home, require no special equipment, and may provide instant inner leg pain relief — even within 30 seconds.

Watch now and fix inner leg, thigh, and groin pain at home!

0:00 Intro
0:34 Butterfly Combo
2:12 Seated Lean
4:00 Side Leg Raise
6:05 Pillow Squeeze
7:45 Side-Step Lunge
9:29 Frog Rocker
